# All models on the same folds and windows (generated by scripts/export_report.py)

Every row uses the same 5 subject folds and is scored on the same 18-s windows (8 epochs, stride 2): classical models average their epoch scores over each window; deep models predict the window directly.
No rest baseline anywhere in this table.
